Description: They build highly specialized physical tools to measure quantum states, like single-photon detectors.
They stick to the theory and the math. They aren't in the business of physically building the computers themselves.
They are a massive player here. They do a ton of physical work with solid-state computing, qubits, and advanced materials.
They do some wild stuff, like blasting superconducting qubits with cosmic rays to test how well they handle noise and interference.
They do hands-on research looking into quantum sensors and the specialized materials needed to build them.
They are looking at how to physically strap quantum sensors onto defense platforms and use quantum computers for logistics.
This is their bread and butter. They are one of the top companies in the world actually building commercial trapped-ion quantum computers.
